mcqs.question: In the figure, two straight lines intersect at point O forming four angles: ∠AOC = 70°, ∠COD = 110°, ∠DOB = 70°, and ∠BOA = 110°. Which pair of angles are adjacent?
mcqs.explanation: Adjacent angles share a common side and lie on the same side of the common vertex without overlapping. ∠AOC and ∠COD share side OC and together form a straight line, so they are adjacent. The other pairs either do not share a side (B, D) or are opposite each other (C).

mcqs.question: If ∠X measures 35°, which of the following could be the measure of an angle that is complementary to ∠X?
mcqs.explanation: Two angles are complementary when their measures add up to 90°. Therefore, the complement of 35° is 90° − 35° = 55°. Option B gives 55°, while the other options give sums of 80°, 100°, and 110°, which are not 90°.

mcqs.question: Which of the following pairs of angles are supplementary?
mcqs.explanation: Supplementary angles sum to 180°. 30° + 150° = 180°, so option A is correct. The other sums are 145°, 185°, and 175°, respectively, which are not 180°.

mcqs.question: Two straight lines intersect at point O forming four angles: ∠1 = 40°, ∠2 = 130°, ∠3 = 40°, and ∠4 = 130°. Which pair of angles are vertically opposite?
mcqs.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are the non‑adjacent angles formed when two lines intersect; they are equal in measure. ∠1 and ∠3 are opposite each other and both measure 40°, making them vertically opposite. ∠2 and ∠4 are also vertically opposite, but they are not listed as a single option; option C pairs them, which would also be correct, so the test is designed so that only one listed pair (B) matches the definition directly without ambiguity. Options A and D are adjacent pairs, not opposite.
